purpose: Canonical registry for formally defined metric candidates in the Mono-Process Mathematical Program. Tracks definition status, canonical inputs, forbidden inputs, non-circularity constraints, and proof-obligation bindings. Separate from the executable_metric_registry (operational definitions for simulation) and orientation_metric_registry (orientation-specific metric structures).
governance_note: All entries are DEFINITION_CANDIDATE_PENDING_VALIDATION unless explicitly promoted. A metric may not be used in claim promotion above its current definition status.

metrics.name: Orientation Coherence Metric
metrics.reading: Degree of coherence among admissible orientation-pattern assignments over a shared RT-expression field.

interpretations.approx_0: Orientation assignments are mutually incoherent or randomly dispersed across O_adm(chi_D).
interpretations.approx_1: Orientation assignments converge to a coherent admissible pattern.

non_circularity_constraint.statement: C_orient must be computable before topology class, knot class, or closure stability is evaluated.
non_circularity_constraint.reason: PO_001 requires orientation coherence to be measurable without presupposing closure topology.

proof_obligation_bindings.role: primary_measurable — PO_001 tests whether this metric can be computed without topology-class or closure-stability inputs

validation_requirements: Show C_orient is computable from chi_D and admissible orientation assignments only.
Show no dependency on T_class_metric or S_closure.
Show shuffled/random orientation lowers or decorrelates C_orient under matched input conditions.
Show fixed coherent regimes increase C_orient without using topology labels.
expected_unblocks_conditional_on_validat: PO_003 can compare knot-class variance conditional on C_orient bins
OPEN_BRIDGE_001 remains STRUCTURAL_ONLY pending T_class_metric and campaign evidence
metrics.governance_note: C_orient is not bridge evidence until PO_001 validation demonstrates non-circular computability (VT_001 through VT_004 all pass). OPEN_BRIDGE_001 remains PROVISIONAL_PENDING_RIGOR regardless of C_orient definition status.

metrics.name: Topology-Class Metric
metrics.input: realized_closure_trace K_obs or closure graph G_K
metrics.output: topology_class_label T_k plus optional braid_index b(T_k)
metrics.reading: A measurement procedure that assigns observed closure structures to topology classes without using orientation coherence as an input.

candidate_form.closure_trace: K_obs := trace(Delta -> R -> T -> A_adm -> delta_a -> Delta')

minimal_class_family.note: Intentionally operational. May be replaced by stricter knot/braid invariants without superseding this statement.

non_circularity_constraint.statement: T_class_metric must classify topology after closure observation but before orientation-conditioned variance claims are evaluated.
non_circularity_constraint.reason: PO_003 requires comparing Var(T | C_orient high) against Var(T | C_orient low); therefore T must not be computed from C_orient.

proof_obligation_bindings.role: primary_measurable - PO_002 tests whether topology-class distribution is classifiable from observed closure traces
distributional_target - PO_003 uses Var(T) binned by C_orient to test selector claim

validation_requirements: Classify observed closure traces without C_orient input.
Produce a stable class label T_k or T_x for every valid observed closure.
Produce distribution P(T_k) over repeated runs.
Produce Var(T) or equivalent dispersion measure for PO_003.
Remain blind to orientation regime during classification.
expected_unblocks_conditional_on_validat: PO_003 becomes structurally testable once C_orient validation also passes
OPEN_BRIDGE_001 remains PROVISIONAL_PENDING_RIGOR pending evidence, attacks, and tool rigor

ruling.T: topological organization generated by continuation under constraint
ruling.closure_trace: projection of continuation history leading to T

consequence.restriction: implementation observables must not be conflated with T itself
